context_requirements: Expression of at least one EP/FP/IP/DP prostanoid receptor
Intact Gs/Gq-coupled signaling to cAMP/Ca2+ and MAPK/AP-1
No requirement for TP53 or RB for the immediate transcriptional response
falsifiers: No consistent induction of FOS, JUN, EGR1, PTGS2 or other AP-1 target genes at 6 h in any line
No repression of proliferation-associated genes at 24 h in any line
Responses that are equally strong in lines lacking all prostanoid receptors

changes: Removed all genes from proximal_down: prostanoid receptor agonists do not acutely repress proliferation genes at 6 h; the listed cell-cycle genes are not immediate targets of Gs/Gq-coupled prostanoid signaling.

Removed all genes from late_down: the same cell-cycle genes were duplicated in both proximal_down and late_down, and their repression is not a specific prostanoid receptor agonist response; proliferation effects are generic and belong in generic_effects.

Kept proximal_up and late_up as listed; FOS, JUN, EGR1, PTGS2, MMP1, CXCL2, IER3, ATF1, CREB1, NFKBIA, ZFP36, DUSP4, DUSP6, RGS2 and TRIB1 are consistent with prostanoid receptor agonist-induced AP-1/CREB/MAPK signaling.
Kept generic_effects proliferation_down and g1_arrest but they are not proximal transcriptional targets.
Kept kinetics fast and magnitude weak for 6 h and 24 h; no evidence supports stronger or slower responses.
Kept all line_response values as weak; no line-specific receptor or driver information justifies stronger responses.
Kept context_requirements and falsifiers; they are consistent with the mechanism.
Evidence list remains empty because no citations were provided.
